finding.claim: ArgumentDefaultsHelpFormatter adds '(default: None)' or '(default: [])' after help text that names the real default. --skills reads 'Default: kmctl's skills ... (default: [])', and --prompt and --system-prompt-file read the same way, so an agent reading the help gets two answers. --model is required but shows '(default: None)'. Drop the formatter and keep the hand-written defaults, or suppress the generated ones for these options.

fixes.change: run_shell starts each command in its own session and kills the process group at the time limit; help drops ArgumentDefaultsHelpFormatter and states each default in its text.
test_shell_time_limit_stops_child_processes checks a child started by the shell is stopped; test_help_shows_no_empty_defaults checks the help shows no empty default and each option names its default.
